fix_5_recenter_full_bleed.note: If the wrapper still has a max-width from another selector, override it on the full-bleed element.

fix_6_chart_mount_width.note: Fixes blank charts caused by the actual Vega mount collapsing to 0px, without changing the chart data or spec.

fix_7_center_chart_output.note: Centers a chart Vega renders narrower than its container (facet/concat/step charts ignore width:container and otherwise left-align). Harmless for full-width charts. Prefer the style rule `.chart .vega-embed svg{display:block;margin:0 auto}` (centers the rendered SVG, mount stays block + width:100%). NEVER use `.vega-embed{display:inline-block}` to center — an inline-block wrapper is shrink-to-fit, so Vega measures it as 0 width and width:container charts render at 0×H (invisible).

fix_8_chart_width_measure.note: Fixes blank/invisible width:container charts whose container measures 0px at inline-script time — the OTHER half that fix_6's mount-width does NOT cover. Measure the real pixel width AFTER layout (DOMContentLoaded + requestAnimationFrame), fall back to parent width or 640 if still 0, cap at the column max, and re-render on resize. Canonical helper: programmer component_implementations.json -> charts_vega_lite.responsive_embed. Apply when charts are blank but the mount is already block + width:100% (fix_6 alone was not enough).

fix_center_wide_breakout.note: margin-inline:auto (and margin:0 auto) CANNOT center an element WIDER than its parent — auto margins only distribute LEFTOVER space, so with no leftover they both collapse to 0 and the element left-aligns + overflows right (PIT-02). Center it with explicit math: margin-inline:calc((100% - min(Wpx,Nvw))/2) using the SAME width expression as the element's width. NEVER use transform:translateX(-50%) to fake it — the layout box stays put so the overflow/horizontal-scroll remains. For a true full-bleed use fix_5_recenter_full_bleed instead.

fix_svg_fit_container.note: A Vega-rendered <svg> is routinely WIDER than spec.width because axes, axis titles and legends draw OUTSIDE the plotting area, so it overflows its container/backing card on the right (PIT-03). Clamp the DRAWN svg to its card with max-width:100%!important (the !important overrides Vega's inline width attribute) + height:auto to preserve aspect + margin-inline:auto to keep it centered. Apply to the shared chart-mount class (.chart-card svg and/or .vega-embed svg). Distinct from fix_7 (which centers a chart Vega renders NARROWER than the mount); this one constrains a chart rendered WIDER than the mount. They compose — keep both.

fix_uniform_fullscreen_scrim.after: ...background images...
fix_uniform_fullscreen_scrim.note: Per-section dark scrim gradients create a visible horizontal SEAM where sections meet over a shared cinematic background (adjacent scrims don't align at the boundary) — PIT-04. Replace them with ONE uniform full-screen filter: a single fixed overlay positioned ABOVE the background images (z-index:-2) but BELOW the content (overlay at z-index:-1), pointer-events:none. If a per-image tint is still needed for contrast, make it flat and identical per image; never stack a second per-section gradient. Seamless because there is exactly one continuous overlay, not N misaligned ones.

fix_no_horizontal_scroll.note: A horizontal-scroll carousel (overflow-x:auto flex row / scroll-snap strip) hides content off-canvas, fights the page's vertical reading flow, and frequently triggers the render audit's horizontalOverflow on mobile. Kill the carousel: convert it to a VERTICAL responsive grid (grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...,1fr))) so every card is visible and the page scrolls one way only. Use minmax(min(280px,100%),1fr) so a single card never forces overflow at narrow widths. Removes overflow-x and any scroll-snap/JS arrows.

fix_9_chart_fault_isolation_iife.note: FM1 (PIT-55) — all charts/interactions share ONE inline <script> run sequentially, so the FIRST synchronous uncaught throw (here `draw(null,…)` derefs null) aborts the whole block and blanks every later chart AND the hero. Wrap each chart/playground setup in its OWN `(function(){ try{…}catch(e){console.error('<id> setup', e)} })()` IIFE so a throw logs and the next chart still mounts. Calling `embedChart` (its body is already try-wrapped) is not enough on its own — the per-chart prep around it runs in the shared block, so wrap the whole setup. render_capture.js surfaces the throw→mass-blank correlation as findings.cascadeScriptAbort; validate.py Section 14 WARNs a multi-mount <script> with no try (chart_no_fault_isolation). Canonical: component_implementations.json charts_vega_lite.fault_isolation_RULE.

fix_11_chart_revisible_repaint.before: vegaEmbed(document.getElementById('des_05'), spec, {actions:false, renderer:'svg'});  // chart inside a hidden tab/accordion/cinematic-revealed beat -> measures 0 at parse -> stays blank when shown
fix_11_chart_revisible_repaint.after: embedChart('des_05', spec, table05);  // embedChart re-paints on first-visible (IntersectionObserver) + on the mount's box growing (ResizeObserver), not just on resize
fix_11_chart_revisible_repaint.note: FM3 (PIT-01) — a width:container chart that starts in a display:none / 0-box container (a tab, an accordion, a cinematic-revealed beat, a data_driven spine, a column that lays out after the inline <script> runs) measures 0px and renders invisible, and a resize-only re-render never fires when it later becomes visible. Route it through the canonical `embedChart` helper, which now also observes first-visible + box-growth and re-paints. Apply when a chart is blank specifically because its container is hidden/0-box at script time. Canonical: component_implementations.json charts_vega_lite.responsive_embed (embed_js).

fix_12_leaflet_invalidate_size.before: var map = L.map('mapMount').setView([lat,lng], 5);  // container hidden/0-height at init, no invalidateSize -> grey/half-painted/0-tile map
fix_12_leaflet_invalidate_size.note: FM4 — a Leaflet map in a hidden / 0-height container renders grey/half-painted/mis-tiled until told its real size. Fix: (1) a FIXED CSS height on the mount BEFORE L.map() init; (2) `map.invalidateSize()` on first-visible (IntersectionObserver — a map inside a tab/accordion/cinematic beat measures 0 at init); (3) a debounced `invalidateSize()` on resize; (4) wrap the whole setup in a try/catch IIFE (FM1) + a `typeof L` CDN-load guard that falls back to a static location table (FM5). render_capture.js findings.brokenMaps (a >0-area .leaflet-container with 0 tiles, or 0-height) is ground truth. Canonical: component_implementations.json maps_leaflet (FM4/FM5).
